title: Pos
description: Get players current location coordinates or ones saved within a minute before the player logged out.
body:
# **Pos**
**Get the current location of a player or the last saved one in case the player is offline. The plugin gathers the location of every player once every 1 minute and saves them into a config file once every 5 minutes or on shutdown.** </br>
![preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6c2cc9501691f8304545d66ee1a6663a2a7a5047.png) </br>
### **Commands:**
**/Pos <PlayerNickName> - get the location. [permission: pos.use]**
### **Tested on 1.21.5 but should work on pretty much any version**
